title: Validation of the Hospital Asthma Severity Score (HASS)
brief_summary: The purpose of this research will be to evaluate the reliability and validity of the HASS tool in a cohort of patients' ages 7 to18 years old against the gold standard of spirometry, and in ages 2 to 6 against spirometry, if possible, and the most similar validated tool, the PRAM.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* asthma exacerbation

Exclusion Criteria:

* continuous albuterol and/or
* pneumonia, croup, varicella, cystic fibrosis, broncho-pulmonary dysplasia, cardiac or kidney disease AND
* previously approached for participation in the study
study_population: Children with asthma exacerbation in the emergency room, inpatient medical units, and medicine intensive care unit
